meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Quick update before we start: Kabir is absent because he's visiting the east depot.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: I brought the passenger feedback sheets.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: I also have the first backend test results.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Let's hear the feedback first.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: Several younger commuters asked whether they could pay directly while boarding.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: Technically, we could accept a phone tap and return a signed payment token.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: That would remove the need to queue before boarding.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: All right, let's allow passengers to pay by tapping their phones on the bus during the pilot.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll need to add the onboard payment event to the API.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: We should make the payment confirmation readable, not just a vibration.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Put that in the usability backlog; we haven't agreed on the exact confirmation design.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: The ticket format is the other issue. Our printer prototype uses a lot of ink.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: We discussed the paper ticket at kickoff, but a QR ticket could be cheaper to verify and easier to audit.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: We've decided to move away from the printed-paper proof we selected earlier. The accepted ticket format will be a QR code.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: I can generate signed QR codes and validate them offline.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: Please make sure screenshots can't be reused on multiple buses.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll investigate replay prevention, but I can't promise a perfect solution by launch.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Keep that as a technical risk until we test it.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: The offline storage limit also needs attention.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: What happens if a bus has a long shift without connectivity?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: The current 200-record cache may fill before the next sync.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: We should retain more records but avoid storing unnecessary passenger information.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Keep offline validation, and raise the local record capacity from 200 to 500 scans.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: I'll store only the scan reference, timestamp, and validation outcome.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: What did the help desk receive after yesterday's trial?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Three passengers called after closing time because their tickets were rejected.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: We could have a rotating contact available around the clock.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Let's make the pilot help desk operate 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: Is that a staffed desk or a telephone contact?

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: I haven't worked out the staffing arrangement yet.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: Then let's document the service expectation and settle the rota separately.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Arjun
meeting_transcripts.content: The QR prototype works on my phone, but I haven't tried it in bright sunlight.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Leena
meeting_transcripts.content: I can arrange a short outdoor usability test.

meeting_transcripts.speaker: Maya
meeting_transcripts.content: Do that before we call the ticket format ready.
